build_dictionary_s2t: build a bilingual training dictionary from source and target embeddings using the S2T direction
build_dictionary_t2s: build a bilingual training dictionary from target to source embeddings using the T2S direction
build_dictionary_intersection: build a bilingual dictionary using the intersection of S2T and T2S candidate pairs
get_candidates_nn: get translation pair candidates using nearest neighbor scoring between two embedding matrices
get_candidates_csls: get translation pair candidates using the contextual dissimilarity measure with k nearest neighbors
